title: Cloudflare partners on Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines for AI agent payments
content:
X author: @Cloudflare

Cloudflare is working with Mastercard and partners to enable trusted agent-to-agent payments for AI agents within defined budgets and permissions via Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines.
